Results.ReviewText: Love it!!! It is the perfect size for my wife and I, even big enough for when we have company. I cooked 12 burgers on it last night.

Results.ReviewText: The product is great, easy to clean . The only problem is the hanging propane tank needs to be a little more convenient. A great unit.
Results.Title: Why I like the unit.

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill.  It starts immediately and cooks evenly. Best grill I have ever had.

Results.ReviewText: The Spirit E-210 Weber Grill has the same quality we found in our other larger Weber grills in the past. We recently moved to a townhouse with a deck . The grill fits perfectly in the space available. We had a propane gas line installed directly to the grill eliminating the need for heavy cylinder propane canisters.

Downsized from a larger grill & we love it.
Plus its more compact!

Results.ReviewText: The grill has great heat distribution. Love the way it grills a few burgers evenly. The control knobs are terrible. You can't determine their position because there is no dial indicator arrow or mark, just a dome grill logo in the middle. The bottom base is flimsy light gauge metal with less than substantial caster mounts. I question the overall durability of the grill.
Results.Title: The grill cooks okay for now.

Results.ReviewText: Heats nicely. The slats are a little too wide and you risk a dropped shrimp or other small objects. Recommend a small grill pan for those items but overall very happy.
Results.Title: Grill slats

Results.ReviewText: Perfect grill.  Very well made and easy to maintain.
Results.Title: The perfect gas grill!

Results.ReviewText: I’ve had Weber grills for 50+ years and my new Spirit lives up to everything I’ve come to expect from Weber. They are the best!
Results.Title: My new Weber Spirit

Results.ReviewText:
I should have bought this grill 50 years ago!
Cooking is easy with the correct equipment.

Results.ReviewText: Clearly I upgraded from grills that I bought knowing they are trash and I'd get 4 years out of them.  This is like going from a Toyota Corolla to a Mercedes.  It burns very hot that takes some getting use too but I am seeing the quality in just a few times that I have use it thus far.
Results.Title: The Bentley of BBQ's

Results.ReviewText: This is the first time I have stepped up to a Weber grill and my grilling experiences have greatly improved and I now look forward to firing up.
Results.Title: Should have done this years ago.

Results.ReviewText: My second Weber, replaced a 7 year old similar product. Happy customer.
Results.Title: My second Weber

Results.ReviewText: I have only used the Weber grill four times since I have had it.  It heats quickly and gets to 500 degrees quickly and cooks at an even temperature once it is adjusted.  It lights very easily.  Both burners cook evenly.  I like my meat to be cooked medium.  I refer to my Weber app and use the suggested heat range and the shortest recommended cooking time. Steaks and pork chops come out perfect, good color and very moist.  I would recommend this Weber grill to anyone who wants a very good compact grill.
Results.Title: Steaks and pork chops come out perfect.

Results.ReviewText: This grill is so predictable in cook temps and time especially steaks and ribs.
Results.Title: Very reliable

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill. It’s perfect for our small family. Very sturdy and heats up quickly!
Results.Title: This grill

Results.ReviewText: Long lasting and very well built. Customer service department was amazing
Results.Title: Weber BBQ

Results.ReviewText: Purchased this grill to replace a 20 year old gas grill of another brand that I could no longer easily get replacement parts for.  Have had it for about a month now and we love it!  heat distribution and control is so much better and the food comes out fantastic.  Design, fit and finish is excellent and well worth the little extra money.  We live in a northern state and grill out year 'round so it will get a lot of use.
Results.Title: New grill exceeds expectations!

Results.ReviewText: Recommend. My 4th Weber - they’ve all been great. Best value, best quality.
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: My second E210... the first one was great, and when it was time for a new one, I didn’t consider any other grills.
Results.Title: Spirit E 210

Results.ReviewText: Love this little guy ,  takes less room on my deck . But can handle the big cooking/ grilling jobs i throw at it . Plus it is heavy as where im at somedays it gets real windy and the last grill i had would end up on its side and the weber still stands all proud through it all upright

Results.ReviewText:
This grill assembly has design issues. It was designed in a way that did not allow water to drain away from the base and side panels. This has resulted in catastrophic failure.

I would not recommend this grill unless it was going to be kept inside out of the weather, all the time.
Results.Title: Durability

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill - second one I’ve  bought and love the size and speed that it heats up and consistency. Gives me what I need with no unnecessary bells and whistles
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: Big grill for a compact price. This grill can comfortably cook for a family of 6.
Results.Title: Great Value for Money

Results.ReviewText: This is a great grill, perfect size for me. The only thing I wish it had was the stainless steel grates but the cast iron still does the job!
Results.Title: Cast iron grates

Results.ReviewText: I give it a 4.5.   really like the grill.  This is my second one.  The one suggestion I have would be in regards to the tank hanging mechanism.  I like to use a gauge on mine as it is more accurate than the hanging mechanism.  With the gauge on the tank valve, I can't close the door properly as it extends out too far.  The problem is the way the tanks are designed the two larger openings for the handles are out of alignment with the hanging mechanism for the use of the gauge.  I suggest changing that mechanism to accomodate.
Results.Title: Nice grill!

Results.ReviewText: Perfect size and as a bonus the arms on the side fold down. Cast iron grates heat food evenly. Replaced my 12 year old three burner grill with this model and I have not been disappointed. Excellent grill.
Results.Title: Perfect Two Burner Grill

46110001.Name: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
